title: BigP3BCI Study S1 — 9x8 face/house paradigm (10 healthy subjects)
description: This dataset contains 32-channel EEG recordings from 10 healthy participants performing a P300-based brain-computer interface speller task. It uses a 9x8 character grid with a face/house stimulus paradigm (Study S1 of BigP3BCI). Target and non-target events are annotated with HED tags. The dataset is a MOABB-derived version of the large public bigP3BCI collection.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.USBamp (g.tec) amplifier at 256 Hz from 32 channels in a standard 10-20 montage, with 60 Hz line frequency. Each participant completed one session in a laboratory setting with online feedback, using a calibration-then-test scheme for P300 detection.
